title: geum canadense var. flavum
intro: Geum canadense var. flavum, commonly known as Canadian Avens or Yellow Avens, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic to promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Geum canadense var. flavum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its ability to relieve pain and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat various health conditions.
